newsitem.title: CHILE: Czech leader talks trade on Chilean visit.
newsitem.headline: Czech leader talks trade on Chilean visit.

text.p: Czech President Vaclav Havel and Chilean leader Eduardo Frei held talks on Monday on ways to boost trade between the two countries which totalled just $17 million last year.
"We have the legal framework to intensify our trade, to intensify our relations and it is significant that within President Havel's delegation are 40 business leaders," Frei told a news conference.
Havel is on the second stage of a Latin American tour which began last week in Brazil and will include visits to Argentina and Uruguay.

He started a three-day official visit on Monday after spending the weekend on Chile's remote Easter Island where he pursued his interest in ancient civilisations among the island's 600 massive statues known as moai.
Havel will open a Czech-Chilean business forum on Tuesday and meet local intellectuals and academics before leaving for Uruguay on Thursday.
